title: CDNCA Edge Site Runtime v2
description: The signed, versioned semantic input for site publication. Array order is significant where marked; references and timeout budgets require semantic validation before activation. Schema name v2 remains stable: site_runtime capability 2 covers the base document, 3 covers HTTP policy/firewall bindings, and 4 covers package limits, listener security, or streams. The declared site_runtime version must exactly match the fields present. Semantic identity, digest, resource collision, and cross-field checks remain mandatory in both producer and consumer.

cache_only.description: L2 configuration cache mode (A19-b, needs l2_routing v1): only a URL a cache rule caches goes through L2, any other to direct_fallback_pool_id.

conditions.description: L2 conditions (A19-b, needs l2_routing v1): a request matching every rule, on one of node_ids when present, goes to endpoint_ids (of every matching condition together); any other to the L2 endpoints no condition names (none: direct).

connections.description: Shared connection budget of the subscription on the node; -1 only with a bandwidth budget.

bandwidth_bps.description: Outbound bandwidth budget of the subscription on the node (bit/s), split between its responses in flight.

siteTrafficLimit.description: Present while the site is over its own traffic cap: every request (ACME HTTP-01 excepted) gets the notice page with status 509.

mode.description: WAF only, needs waf v2: observe records every decision as log and enforces nothing.

auto_block.description: WAF only, needs waf v2: ban a client after hit_threshold block / challenge decisions within window_seconds.

action.description: challenge / ban: WAF only, need waf v2 and action_config.

port_end.description: Last port of a port range port..port_end (at most 1000 ports, never covering 80, 443, 18080 or 18443). Requires tcp/udp API v9.
Last port of a port range port..port_end (at most 1000 ports, never covering 80, 443, 18080 or 18443). Requires tcp/udp API v9.

follow_port.description: Connect to the origin on the port the client connected to (port equals the primary listener port). Requires tcp/udp API v9.

drain_max_ms.description: How long sessions of a worker generation retired by a reload may keep running; 0 is unlimited. Omitted: the agent default (24 h). Requires tcp/udp API v5.

new_conn_rate.description: Per-client new connection (UDP: session) rate: a token bucket of rate_per_second + burst refilled at rate_per_second; over the limit the connection is refused and, with ban_seconds > 0, the client is refused for that long. Requires tcp/udp API v6.

session_log.description: Write a per-session access log (client, upstream, bytes, duration and end reason, refused sessions included) to the node's L4 telemetry spool. Requires tcp/udp API v7.

guard_rules.description: L4 guard rules, evaluated in order on each new connection (UDP: session) in preread; the first rule whose conditions all hold decides: drop closes it, ban closes it and refuses the client for ban_seconds once it hit the rule threshold times within window_seconds, allow ends rule evaluation. Requires tcp/udp API v10; a geo condition also requires ip_intel v2.

first_packet.description: The first data the client sends (first TCP segment within the preread wait, at most 512 bytes, or the first UDP datagram); a client that sends nothing does not match.

server_names.description: TLS SNI (ssl_preread) of a TLS passthrough stream.

geo.description: IP intelligence conditions (country, carrier / IDC tag, ASN, province, city), all of which must hold.
